name: Ace
summary: One back, four receivers. The answer when they have put eight men in the box against everything else.
personnel: 11 players, split end, tight end, slot, flanker, quarterback, tailback
notes: One back, four receivers spread across the field. This is our spread-them-out formation: it pulls defenders away from the middle and gives us the widest, thinnest box we will see all game. Seven on the line — split end, five interior linemen and the tight end — with the slot and the flanker off it.
coaching_notes: Only run this if the kids can line up correctly without being walked out there. Four receivers is four chances to get an illegal formation flag.
One back means we cannot out-muscle anybody. Everything here works by making them defend width first.
The split end is ON the line and the slot is OFF it. Check it every snap.
Use this late in a game when they have stacked eight men in the box against our other formations.
